tasks.ask: Query sf_ops.incidents for station_id='F10': return ts, shift_code, kind, cause, severity, downtime_min, cars_lost, outdoor_temp_c, agv_id, description ordered by ts desc to find recurring stop causes at F10.

Query sf_ops.andon_events for station_id='F10': return ts, shift_code, reason, responder_id, response_s, stopped_line, incident_id ordered by ts desc to identify stop triggers and line stoppages at F10.

Query sf_plant.machine_telemetry joined to sf_plant.machines where station_id='F10': return ts, machine_id, failure, heat_dissipation_failure, overstrain_failure, air_temp_k, process_temp_k, rpm, torque_nm where any failure flag=1 ordered by ts desc to find machine-driven F10 stops.
